manifest.goal: Preserve the full fractal token-native HSWM target while selecting an independently evaluable failure family and a measurable outcome-conditioned relation update rule.

sources.title: Actual USL relation instrument result and limitations
OpenAI reported research method; stronger internal discovery model, Astra formalization
Integrated first research round and rejected static-wrapper design
Known fixed program structural observation; no model efficacy
Existing bounded scalar update and selection functions

hypotheses.claim: An outcome-bound relation revision can improve a later unseen task beyond the same model with the same available history and budget.
hypotheses.scope: Candidate research question only; current instrument does not establish independent outcome custody, G0/G1, or FCL passage.
hypotheses.falsifier: A capable matched-history native agent explains the gain, or removing the exact revision does not remove the gain and restoring it does not restore the gain.

hypotheses.claim: The apparent benefit can be explained by ordinary history, a text lesson, or a reusable program without the proposed relation mechanism.
hypotheses.scope: Competing null explanation for the same declared task family and model/tool budget.
hypotheses.falsifier: A prospectively measured contribution survives strong matched baselines and specific remove/restore interventions on held-out tasks.

hypotheses.claim: A declared outcome-conditioned update of a relation choice policy improves a later independently scored episode beyond independently updated strong native-history/text/program controls under the same total resource cap.
hypotheses.scope: RU-1 design candidate; cohort, provider configuration and analysis not yet fixed. No canonical admission, independent causal credit, model efficacy or FCL claim.
hypotheses.falsifier: A valid adequately sensitive comparison attributes the apparent gain to a strong history/text/program learner, or exact revision removal and restoration fail to identify the predeclared contribution. Invalid custody, leakage and saturation leave efficacy unjudged.

tasks.question: Select one replayable real diagnostic/repair failure family with source cutoff, independent outcome custodian and disclosed development cases. Determine whether existing scalar context loses needed distinctions. Preserve unused ALFWorld holdouts.
tasks.acceptance: Return exact source/replay boundary, evaluator responsibility, allowed actor information, unknowns, and a prospectively justified cohort/metric plan. No claim of independent custody from process separation alone.

tasks.question: Resolve the caller-supplied endpoint/model/credential-environment configuration and common native session/tool surface. Current values are missing; do not infer them or extract ChatGPT credentials. Define total-cap and actual-usage measurement.
tasks.acceptance: Return source-bound configuration contract without secret values, actual accounting capability and explicit unknowns; do not count equal caps as equal realized costs or claim execution if configuration remains missing.

tasks.question: Assess the selected cohort and update-law contrast against independent learners, exact-content equivalence audit, frozen/sham/remove/restore and outcome custody.
tasks.acceptance: Fix source, model, resource caps, primary metric, cohort analysis and stopping before evaluation. Record unresolved conditions; no criteria relaxation or static-wrapper efficacy claim.
